meta.title: Platform Settings
meta.description: Manage system and operational platform configuration safely.

page.title: Platform Settings Control Center
page.description: Review and customize platform operational parameters and general policies. Every modification requires an audit reason. Sensitive keys and payment configurations remain isolated in dedicated control centers.

domains.allDesc: High-level overview across all six platform configuration and operational domains.
domains.sessionsDesc: Instant booking SLAs, session join and reconnect buffers, and package plans.
domains.notificationsDesc: Session reminder countdown timeline, late arrival alerts, and delivery channels.
domains.revenue_shareDesc: Unified platform commission rate and practitioner session earnings split.
domains.paymentsDesc: Paymob and Stripe providers, maintenance modes, and currency routing summary.
domains.storageDesc: Attachment size limits for chat, profile avatars, practitioner credentials, and certificates.
domains.generalDesc: Default language, practitioner review governance, and security policies overview.

header.title: Sessions & Booking Settings
header.description: Manage instant booking response deadlines, virtual room entry and reconnection grace windows, and session package plan availability.

instantBooking.title: Instant Booking SLAs & Thresholds
instantBooking.description: Determines platform and practitioner response speed for on-demand Instant Booking requests.

roomAccess.title: Session Room Access & Reconnect Buffers
roomAccess.description: Control pre-start check-in windows and post-session reconnection grace periods.

packages.title: Session Package Plans
packages.description: Control visibility and checkout purchasing for standardized multi-session packages.

instantRequestTtl.title: Practitioner Instant Request Response Window
instantRequestTtl.description: Maximum minutes a practitioner has to accept or reject an instant booking request before automatic expiration.
instantRequestTtl.impact: Applies to new instant requests only

instantPaymentWindow.title: Patient Instant Payment Completion Window
instantPaymentWindow.description: Minutes allowed for the patient to complete checkout after practitioner acceptance before slot release.
instantPaymentWindow.impact: Applies to new instant requests only

earlyJoin.title: Early Session Room Join Window
earlyJoin.description: Minutes before scheduled start when participants can enter the virtual room to verify camera and audio.
earlyJoin.impact: Applies to new scheduled sessions only

afterEndGrace.title: Post-Session Reconnect Grace Period
afterEndGrace.description: Additional grace window after scheduled end during which room link remains available to resume if disconnected.
afterEndGrace.impact: Applies to new scheduled sessions only

packagesEnabled.title: Enable Package Plans Visibility
packagesEnabled.description: Show standardized session packages across patient discovery and practitioner matching pages.
packagesEnabled.impact: Immediate effect on public patient discovery

packagesPurchaseEnabled.title: Allow Package Purchases
packagesPurchaseEnabled.description: Allow patients to purchase package bundles and generate billing invoices.
packagesPurchaseEnabled.impact: Immediate effect on package checkout flows

confirmModal.title: Confirm Session Setting Modification
confirmModal.subtitle: Review previous and proposed values and provide a mandatory audit reason before saving.
confirmModal.highRiskWarning: High Risk Operational Alert: Modifying Instant Booking SLAs directly impacts practitioner response rates and fast-booking fulfillment.
confirmModal.reasonLabel: Operational Change Reason (Mandatory for Audit Log)
confirmModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the operational justification for this change...

header.title: Revenue Share & Commission Split
header.description: Configure platform commission and practitioner payout splits for local and cross-border sessions with live payment calculation simulations.

local.title: Local Sessions Revenue Share (Same Country)
local.description: Determines platform commission and practitioner share when patient and practitioner reside in the same country (Default: Platform 30% / Practitioner 70%).

crossBorder.title: Cross-Border Sessions Revenue Share (Cross Country)
crossBorder.description: Determines platform commission and practitioner share when patient and practitioner are in different countries (Default: Platform 50% / Practitioner 50%).

confirmModal.title: Confirm Revenue Share Modification
confirmModal.warning: High Financial Sensitivity Warning: Modifying revenue share percentages applies exclusively to future sessions and transactions. Existing transactions and ledger snapshots are immutable.
confirmModal.impactText: Applies only to new financial transactions. Existing payments are not changed.
confirmModal.reasonLabel: Financial Change Reason (Mandatory for Audit Log)
confirmModal.reasonPlaceholder: Provide operational or commercial justification for this percentage update...

header.title: Payments & Gateway Orchestration
header.description: Manage active payment gateways, maintenance modes, default checkout methods, supported currencies, and secure key encryption.

paymob.name: Paymob Gateway
paymob.description: Primary card and digital wallet payment processor for Egyptian Pound (EGP) transactions.
paymob.supportedMethods: Bank Cards, Mobile Wallets (Vodafone Cash, Orange, etc.)

stripe.name: Stripe Gateway
stripe.description: Global payment processor for international cards and GCC currencies.
stripe.supportedMethods: International Credit/Debit Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay

readiness.readinessNote: Payment activation requires completing provider configuration and environment secrets.

controls.enabledDesc: Controls whether this gateway is active for patient checkout flows.
controls.maintenanceModeDesc: Temporarily pauses new checkout sessions through this gateway during maintenance without affecting other providers.
controls.checkoutFlowDesc: Integration method used to present the payment window to patients.
controls.defaultMethodDesc: Preferred checkout method presented by default to the patient.
controls.allowedCountriesDesc: Country ISO codes authorized to process payments via this gateway.

secrets.title: Encrypted Credentials & Secrets
secrets.description: Gateway API keys and secrets are securely encrypted in the platform vault and never exposed in plaintext.
secrets.vaultNotice: Secured by Platform Vault & Zero-Knowledge Encryption.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Payment Gateway Setting Modification
confirmModal.warning: High Operational Risk Alert: Modifying gateway routing or maintenance states directly impacts checkout availability for new patient sessions.
confirmModal.impactText: Changes affect new payment attempts only.
confirmModal.reasonLabel: Operational Change Reason (Mandatory for Audit Log)
confirmModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the operational justification for updating payment gateway settings...

header.title: Notifications & Operational Alerts
header.description: Manage scheduled session reminder timelines, late attendance alerts, and delivery channels across in-app push and email.

channels.title: Delivery Channels Matrix
channels.description: Enable or disable real-time delivery channels for patients and practitioners.

schedule.title: Scheduled Session Reminders (Reminder Offsets)
schedule.description: Configure pre-start reminder time intervals prior to session start.

lateAlerts.title: Late Attendance Alerts
lateAlerts.description: Automated alert sent to participants who have not joined after scheduled session start.

labels.inAppDesc: Deliver instant notifications in patient and practitioner app notification centers.
labels.emailDesc: Send automated transactional emails with session calendar invites and reminders.
labels.lateEnabledDesc: Trigger reminders when participants have not joined the session room after start.
labels.lateDelayDesc: Minutes after scheduled session start before dispatching late join alert.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Notification & Alert Modification
confirmModal.warning: Operational Alert: Modifying reminder schedules and channels directly impacts session attendance reminders and participant engagement.
confirmModal.impactText: Applies immediately to all upcoming scheduled sessions and reminders.
confirmModal.reasonLabel: Operational Change Reason (Mandatory for Audit Log)
confirmModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the operational reason for modifying notification rules...

header.title: Media & Storage Limits Control
header.description: Manage attachment size quotas, avatar and credential upload policies, and authorized file extension formats.

chat.title: Chat Attachments & Media Messages
chat.description: Control attachment toggles and maximum single image/document file size quotas in private consultations.

profiles.title: Profile Avatars & Identity Images
profiles.description: Maximum image upload limits for patient and practitioner profile photos.

documents.title: Practitioner Credentials & Verification Proofs
documents.description: Maximum file size limits for medical licenses, accreditation documents, and payout receipts.

academy.title: Content Publishing & Academy Assets
academy.description: Maximum image and certificate file size limits for articles and academy programs.

labels.enableChatUploadsDesc: Controls whether patients and practitioners can upload files inside active session chat rooms.
labels.chatMaxImageSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size per individual image attachment in chat.
labels.chatMaxDocSizeDesc: Maximum allowed size per individual document attachment (PDF, DOCX, etc.).
labels.chatMaxFilesPerMsgDesc: Number of file attachments allowed in a single chat message.
labels.patientAvatarSizeDesc: Maximum file size for patient avatar uploads.
labels.practitionerAvatarSizeDesc: Maximum file size for practitioner avatar uploads.
labels.practitionerCredSizeDesc: Maximum file size for licensing certificates and credentials.
labels.payoutProofSizeDesc: Maximum file size for payout confirmation documents.
labels.impactScope: Applies to new file uploads only. Existing files remain unaffected.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Storage & Media Policy Modification
confirmModal.warningMedium: Operational Alert: Modifying maximum upload limits affects storage consumption and bandwidth quotas.
confirmModal.warningHigh: High Risk Alert: Disabling file uploads will immediately block user document and image submission workflows.
confirmModal.impactText: Applies to new file uploads only. Existing stored files remain unaffected.
confirmModal.reasonLabel: Operational Change Reason (Mandatory for Audit Log)
confirmModal.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the operational justification for updating storage policy or limits...

states.empty: No settings match your search or filter criteria.

commission.title: Platform Commission
commission.description: Set the single authoritative platform commission for future session allocations. The practitioner share is always the exact remainder to 100.00%.
commission.derivedHint: Derived by the Backend as 100.00% minus platform commission.
commission.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this financial split is changing...
commission.mismatch: The existing local and cross-border defaults are different. Choose one platform commission and save to explicitly unify both defaults.
commission.saved: Commission saved for future allocations. Existing payment and ledger snapshots were not changed.
commission.error: The commission could not be saved. Reload the latest value and try again.
commission.note: This change is audited and applies prospectively. Accountant approval and immutable payment snapshots remain authoritative for historical earnings.

history.title: Audit & Change History
history.subtitle: Track historical modifications made to this setting along with actor details and audit reasons.
history.empty: No previous change history recorded for this setting.
